name: Low Downside-Beta Defensive Tilt
description: Long-only defensive tilt toward the lowest-downside-beta assets (Ang, Chen & Xing 2006). Downside beta is estimated only on down-market days (market proxy IWRD/VUSA below its trailing mean), isolating crash co-movement. Ranks ascending and equal-weights the bottom N. Distinct from the full-beta LowBetaTilt and total-vol LowVolatilityTilt.
